items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Did you ever hear of a guy named Dave Riddick?

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I'm having trouble. Yeah, the 14th.
Did you ever hear of a guy named Dave Riddick? I've only heard of one other musician named Riddick other than your family. He wasn't from here, I don't think.

Now there is a Riddick here that's a heart specialist, Dr. Frank Riddick. There are several Riddicks here. A.G. Riddick, Archie Riddick. But now, Dr. Frank Riddick, and we are definitely a distant blood relative. Because we all came from the same neck of the woods, Virginia.
